title: Capillary-Driven Passive Water Purification Using Hierarchical Porous Ceramics
abstract: A gravity-fed purification device with hierarchically porous ceramic driving water transport by capillary action rejecting pathogens without energy.
claims: Alumina-silica ceramic with trimodal pores: macro (30-80um), meso (200-800nm), micro (2-10nm).
Silver nanoparticle coating providing bactericidal activity below 100 ppb.
Fabrication by sacrificial template using PMMA microspheres and surfactant micelles.
problem_statement: 2.2 billion lack safe water. Passive capillary systems could provide zero-energy purification.
